art_direction: Dark luxury with an editorial feel, targeting premium hospitality consulting. The design must communicate executive-level expertise, timeless elegance, and prestige without excessive decoration. It focuses on a cinematic, moody atmosphere with deep navy backgrounds and refined gold accents.

headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) and leading-none for H1/H2 to create an editorial, classic luxury feel. Avoid Inter for headings.

body.usage: Clean, crisp sans-serif for optimal readability in data and body copy. Use leading-relaxed.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter font-light text-white
hierarchy.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl tracking-tight font-light text-white
hierarchy.overline: text-xs md:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#D4AF37] font-medium

spacing_and_layout.strategy: Embrace asymmetry and generous negative space (p-12 to p-32). Avoid perfectly centering all content; create visual tension through left-aligned blocks offset by rich photography.

surfaces.cards: Solid dark navy (bg-[#0A1120]) with a subtle border (border border-white/5). Do not use drop shadows. On hover: border-[#D4AF37]/50 and a slight upward transform (-translate-y-1).
surfaces.glass: Crystal Glass variant: bg-[#050B14]/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10. Use for the sticky header to maintain readability.
surfaces.inputs: bg-[#0A1120] border border-white/10 text-white placeholder-white/40 focus:border-[#D4AF37] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#D4AF37] rounded-none px-4 py-3

motion.hero_reveal: Signature on-load moment: Masked line-by-line reveal for H1 text using Framer Motion (overflow-hidden wrapper, text translates up from 100% to 0%).
motion.scroll_reveal: Subtle fade-in and translateY(30px) triggered on scroll. Stagger children for lists/grids to create a cascading effect.
motion.interactions: Hover states must include a transition (e.g., transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 0.3s ease).

buttons.primary: bg-[#D4AF37] text-[#050B14] px-8 py-4 uppercase tracking-wider text-xs md:text-sm font-semibold hover:bg-[#E5C158] transition-colors rounded-none
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#D4AF37] text-[#D4AF37] px-8 py-4 uppercase tracking-wider text-xs md:text-sm font-semibold hover:bg-[#D4AF37]/10 transition-colors rounded-none

components.navigation: Sticky top-0 z-50 Crystal Glass header. Desktop links clearly visible (no hamburger on desktop). Elegant line-through or gold underline on hover.
components.marquee: A very slow editorial marquee. Font: Cormorant Garamond italic. Huge text (text-6xl or 8xl) with transparent fill and 1px white/20 stroke for a cinematic background texture.
components.accordion: FAQ Accordion using Shadcn. Flat design, border-b border-white/10 only, no side borders. Gold plus/minus icon.
components.forms: Use Shadcn forms heavily customized to fit the luxury dark theme. Flat inputs, no border-radius. Submit button uses primary button styles.

Home.Hero: Fullscreen kinetic hero. Background: Dark architectural/hospitality image with a heavy bg-[#050B14]/60 overlay. Masked line-by-line reveal for 'Strategy for Growth'. Subtle 3D/Parallax effect on scroll.
Home.About_Preview: Asymmetrical layout. Large typography on left, overlapping clipped images on right.
Home.Marquee: Slow moving 'PREMIUM HOSPITALITY CONSULTING' in outline serif font.
Home.Services_Preview: Interactive bento grid (9 service categories). Cards reveal a gold border and brief description on hover.
Home.Why_Choose_Us: Animated feature cards with animated statistics counters (using framer-motion useSpring/useMotionValue).
Home.Consulting_Process: Animated 6-step timeline. A vertical line traces downwards on scroll, lighting up each step in gold.
Home.Industries: Cards showcasing distinct hospitality sectors (Resorts, Chains, Investors) with distinct hover imagery.
Home.Testimonials: Minimalist carousel or grid. Large serif quotation marks in gold.
Home.Lead_Generation: Title: 'Let's Discuss Your Hotel's Growth'. High-end multi-field enquiry form on a rich dark background.
Home.Footer: Massive py-24 padding. Large logo. Newsletter signup form. Contact details prominently displayed.

page_blueprints.About: Deep dive into the firm's ethos. Numbered manifesto chapters with heavy use of typography and negative space. Team section with high-contrast grayscale portraits.
page_blueprints.Services: Detailed list of the 9 categories. Each section features a large image and a grid of specific deliverables.
page_blueprints.Industries: Detailed breakdown of served markets. Case study highlights.
page_blueprints.Consulting_Process: An expanded, fully interactive version of the home timeline. Deep dive into Kencroft's methodology.
page_blueprints.Blog: Editorial grid. Categories filter. Article pages feature a large header image, narrow reading column (max-w-2xl), and drop caps.
page_blueprints.Contact: Two-column layout. Left: Contact info (info@kencroftstrategy.in, +91 8909206368) and a sleek WhatsApp CTA button. Right: The premium lead-generation form. Map placeholder below.
page_blueprints.Admin_Dashboard: Protected route. Strict dense grid layout (Archetype 4/5 hybrid). Shadcn data tables to view captured leads. Solid backgrounds, functional clarity.

hero_background.description: Ornate building illuminated with warm yellow lights at night, sets a prestigious tone.

about_section.description: Two business professionals discussing strategy inside a luxurious setting, emphasizing executive consulting.

services.description: High-end resort pool, representing hospitality operations.

process.description: Empty conference room with a panoramic city view, symbolizing high-level strategic planning.

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='contact-form-submit').

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in CSS.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
NEVER use placeholder text for images. Only use the provided image URLs.
All navigation must be visible on desktop. No hamburger menus on desktop viewports.
Header must have a background (e.g., Crystal Glass). Do not use fully transparent headers over hero images.
Do not use generic SaaS blue. Stick strictly to the defined Dark Navy and Gold palette.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
